agent_summary:
Found two up-to-date replacements for the discontinued `mas_housing_loans_discontinued` series (which only went to 2015-Q3). Both are from Singapore Department of Statistics' "Commercial Banks: Loans And Advances To Residents By Industry" datasets:

1. Monthly series (d_af0415517a3a3a94b3b74039934ef976): Covers 2021-07 to 2026-07, last updated 2026-08-31
2. Quarterly series (d_0396bc943075a37d44c720ceb5be660a): Covers 2021-07 to 2026-06, last updated 2026-08-11

Both measure "Consumer Loans - Housing And Bridging Loans" in Million Dollars from the original publisher (Singapore Department of Statistics). Both are proposed with channel "Mortgage credit", affecting both sales and rents positively. The monthly series is more recent but the quarterly provides a longer-term view consistent with the original discontinued series' frequency.
